dataset_spec.name: dryad_er_cbc
dataset_spec.description: Northern-Italy emergency-room blood-cell differential (first 1000 adults). Binary all-cause death from age, sex, COVID-wave period, and baseline CBC indices.
dataset_spec.setting: Adult emergency-room presentation with a complete blood-cell differential at first draw. The prediction uses age, sex, epidemic period, and named CBC indices, not follow-up time or outcome-tuned score columns.

covid_wave.text_label: ER period relative to COVID-19 surges

er_death.question: Based on the emergency-room blood-cell differential, will the patient die during follow-up?
